description: Bullrun's Global Markets dashboard in one call: world equity indices (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, MSCI World, DAX, FTSE 100, Nikkei, Hang Seng, Nifty...), central-bank policy rates and next rate decisions (Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, SNB, BoC), 16 sovereign 10-year yields, 20 FX pairs, oil/gas/gold/copper, headline macro tiles (global GDP growth, inflation, debt/GDP, VIX, DXY, 2s10s curve, US jobless claims), the upcoming economic calendar, market news and the US housing balance. Each row carries a historyCode for get_macro_history. Use for "how are markets doing today", "what's the macro backdrop", "where are rates/yields", "what's on the calendar this week" or a morning briefing. Daily closes, with live intraday index levels while markets are open. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

newsLimit.description: Headlines to return when the news section is requested.

sections.description: Sections to return. headline = global GDP/inflation/debt, oil, gold, DXY, US 10Y, 2s10s curve, VIX, EUR/USD, Bitcoin, policy-rate average, OECD unemployment, US jobless claims; indices = 19 world equity indices (live intraday level when a market is open); rates = six major central-bank policy rates + upcoming rate decisions; yields = 16 sovereign 10Y yields; currencies = 20 FX pairs; commodities = Brent, WTI, natural gas, gold, copper; calendar = upcoming high-impact economic releases; news = market headlines; us_housing = US housing-market balance (months' supply, inventory, price cuts). Default: everything except news and us_housing.
